**Severity:** error · **Area:** Syntax / JSX / attributes (`RV1xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads:

```text
Unknown native event: {name}
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use a known DOM event name (onClick, onInput, …) or, for a custom event, the `on:my-event={…}` form.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
export const A = () => <div onFrobnicate={() => 1} />;
```

```tsx prefer
export const A = () => <div on:frobnicate={() => 1} />;
```

## When it is reported

Could suggest the nearest event name.
